svg.aria-label: Presentation box, open: lid, spine, tray with two rings and the plan sheet
svg.title: Presentation box, open: lid, spine, tray with two rings and the plan sheet

text.tspan: Floor planning at Sahra is approached as a balance between functionality, flow and spatial
clarity, where each layout is designed to support natural movement and everyday living. The
organization of spaces prioritizes openness, proportion and seamless transitions between areas,
ensuring both comfort and efficiency. Every plan is carefully structured to maximize usability
while maintaining a refined architectural rhythm that enhances the overall living experience.
